~ Untitled Discourse on Greed (2nd)

“Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya cha dhammā bhāvetabbā. “For insight into greed, six things should be developed. Katame cha? What six? Buddhānussati, dhammānussati, saṅghānussati, sīlānussati, cāgānussati, devatānussati. The recollection of the Buddha, the teaching, the Saṅgha, ethics, generosity, and the deities. Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime cha dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti. For insight into greed, these six things should be developed.”
